scientific.integrity: The corrected-momentum update is specialized directly to an additive-noise quadratic. A change from estimator state to estimator error makes the recursion triangular, and exact scalar Lyapunov equations give the stationary covariance and SGD comparison.
limitations: Constant parameters are analyzed rather than the published adaptive STORM schedule.
Exact decoupling requires additive gradient noise with deterministic curvature.
The theorem is scalar and concerns stationary second moments rather than finite-time oracle complexity.
Very small momentum weight lowers stationary variance while slowing the estimator-memory mode.

title: Exact stationary covariance and stability factorization for constant-template STORM
